tasks.description: Comprehensive verification of the Trailblaze Auto platform, covering public car  Catalogue browsing and secure administrative management systems.
acceptance_criteria: The application landing page must load successfully, displaying the main branding message 'Drive Your Dream' and a navigation bar with a link to ' Catalogue'.
Selecting the ' Catalogue' link redirects the user to the /browse page, which fetches and displays a gallery of vehicle cards with Name, Brand, and Price.
Clicking on a specific vehicle card in the public gallery navigates the user to the /car/:id page, showing detailed specifications including Transmission, Fuel Type, and Seating.
Selecting the 'History' tab on a specific vehicle's detail page displays a chronological log of verified ownership transfers and transaction prices.
The /browse page 'New Arrivals' filter successfully isolates and displays only vehicles with a 'Brand New' condition status.
The /browse page 'Pre-Owned' filter successfully isolates and displays only vehicles with a 'Pre-Owned' (Used) condition status.
Selecting the 'All' filter on the /browse page resets condition-based filters to display the entire available vehicle  Catalogue.
Entering valid admin credentials on the /admin login page successfully authenticates the session and redirects to the /admin/dashboard.
The /admin/dashboard page must display global statistics (All Vehicles) and a recent  Catalogue list for high-level management.
The 'Add New Vehicle' wizard successfully creates a showroom-ready vehicle when the 'Brand New' condition is selected.
The 'Add New Vehicle' wizard successfully creates a 'Pre-Owned' vehicle, allowing valid input for the number of previous owners.
The 'Edit Car' feature allows administrators to modify any property of an existing vehicle record, with updates reflecting across public and admin views.
The /admin/ Catalogue page allows administrators to manage vehicle availability through Approve/Reject/Return to Available status transition workflows.
The /admin/profile page allows the current administrator to update their personal details including Name, Bio, and Phone number.
The /admin/profile security sector supports updating the administrator password to ensure sustained account security.
Entering incorrect credentials on the /admin login page displays a validation error notification and denies entry.
Attempting to submit or progress through the 'Add New Vehicle' wizard while leaving mandatory fields empty triggers browser or UI validation blocks.
Users attempting to navigate directly to protected routes like /admin/dashboard or /admin/ Catalogue without a session are forced back to the login page.
Navigating to a non-existent or invalid vehicle ID (e.g., /car/non-existent) displays a 'Vehicle Not Found' message and a return-to-fleet option.
Providing an invalid or unreachable image URL in the Add/Edit form correctly handles error states by falling back to a default asset placeholder.
Attempting to synchronize the administrative profile with invalid data (e.g., removing a mandatory Full Name) prevents the update operation.
The application must support an Administrative 'Sign Up' process that successfully registers new administrators and redirects them to the admin login portal.
Administrators must be able to securely authenticate via the '/admin' portal to access the centralized fleet management dashboard.
